title: Inmigración
goal: Read how Argentina's "gobernar es poblar" policy drew roughly six million European immigrants between 1880 and 1930, and how they organized mutual aid societies and lived in crowded conventillos.

items: Quote Alberdi's famous summary of Argentina's migration policy.
State roughly how many immigrants arrived in Argentina between 1880 and 1930.
Explain how foreign-born Buenos Aires had become by 1914.
Describe what conventillos were and who lived in them.
Use para que + subjunctive to describe a deliberate policy's purpose.
